mapper.select: SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND action IN ('project.create','project.read','profile.confirm','project.manage','project.task.read','task.read','run.read','work_item.read') AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.project_id,p.status,p.revision,r.name,r.responsible_user_id,r.current_profile_revision, r.creation_basis,r.creation_basis_sha256,r.creation_reason,r.authority_grant,r.authority_revision, r.schema_version,r.schema_manifest_sha256,r.created_by,r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.revision AS metadata_revision FROM project p JOIN project_record r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.project_id=p.project_id WHERE p.project_id=#{projectId} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE project_record SET current_profile_revision=#{profileId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND revision=#{expected} AND current_profile_revision=#{oldProfile}
UPDATE project SET status=#{newStatus},revision=revision+1 WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND status=#{oldStatus} AND revision=#{expected}
UPDATE project_record SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('decision_id',decision_id,'operation_id',operation_id,'decision',decision,'from_status',from_status, 'to_status',to_status,'expected_revision',CAST(expected_revision AS CHAR),'resulting_revision',CAST(resulting_revision AS CHAR), 'profile_revision',profile_revision,'reason',reason,'impact',impact,'authority_grant',authority_grant,'authority_revision',CAST(authority_revision AS CHAR)) FROM project_state_decision d WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND decision_id=#{decisionId}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
